lanes.title: the research screen and an accurate tree: the inspector's labels, polish N2-N4 and N6, the date review's H1, H2, B1, K1, W1, W2 (D-089 DH4-DH7)
lanes.brief:
SCOPE (D-089 DH4, DH6 and DH7; READING DH7-R1 (a)): this lane may change Sim.Ui (the research screens under Sim.Ui/Progression) with Sim.Ui.Tests; Sim.Core/State (InfoQuery, and the read-only queries its labels need; DH4 allows it) with Sim.Tests; Sim.Data/content/research.json, the research layout and the generated research reports (DH7 allows prerequisites, depths, the tree's shape and D-047 dates to change where cited evidence requires), with the content tests, the date test and the research tools' outputs. Nothing in Sim.Core/Kernel. No change to simulation state or the world hash except what a content change causes, and every moved golden or pin carries a measured attribution. No permanent project, no CI change, no merge, tag or release.

READ FIRST: docs/d089-fought-capture-choice-research-tree-launcher-director-answers-2026-11-12.md in full (DH4 to DH7, DH7-R1, DH5); D-084, D-047 (the causal date rule and its test), D-070, D-061, D-072, D-073, D-069 and docs/ip-originality.md; docs/m6-plan/research-tree-fixes-2026-11.md (§4's N1 to N6, and the readings), docs/m6-plan/research-date-review-2026-11.md in full (§5's H1, H2, B1, K1, W1 and W2 with their sources) and docs/m6-plan/research-tree-audit-2026-11-10.md; reports/H-RT.md; docs/validation-policy.md; the research tools in scripts/ (research_lib.py, research-content-audit.py, research-calibration-report.py, research-consequence-audit.py, research-gameplay-unlock-audit.py, the tree-closure check) and how the generated reports are rebuilt.

(1) THE INSPECTOR'S LABELS (DH4; lane RT's N1). InfoQuery's ENABLED BY and WHY LOCKED rows keep grouped prerequisite expressions (the expression-tree model lane RT gave the graph and the detail pane), with no per-atom 'required' or 'one of' label that misstates a nested group. The same holds for the 'a prerequisite of ...' links of non-node cards (B.Build) and for entity cards (EntityAtoms, EntityWhyLocked). Truth-table tests for the grouped expressions, and a corpus-wide test that every representation keeps its expression's truth table.

(2) POLISH (DH6). N2: the dependent hover edges are readable, at least 3:1 against the field in every Age (cased or re-inked), MEASURED per Age. N3: the spine's lane spacing is tied to the stroke width, so that a pin's five cased edges do not merge; this is a layout change, so measure the card widths before and after and move pins with attribution. N4: subheadings 'Research stage' and 'Age IV sweep' under REQUIRES, or a 'Why locked' block (display only). N6: a route-aware estimate for a node not yet open (step the lane's funding along the route, bank-aware for Civics, one shared function with the existing estimate), MEASURED on Gift exchange and War band. READING RT2-R1: (a) N6's route-aware figure replaces lane RT's 'no figure for a civic not yet open' (DH6 is the later and more specific decision; DH5 keeps lane RT's other two readings); (b) N6 serves technologies only, and a civic not yet open keeps no figure. Apply (a) and flag it for the Director. A capture of each change.

(3) AN ACCURATE TREE (DH7; DH7-R1 (a)). Resolve each of H1, H2, B1, K1, W1 and W2 to the option that its cited evidence supports, after checking each source yourself; a source you cannot verify is reported, not relied on. Change prerequisites, depths and the tree's shape where accuracy needs it. Move a D-047 date where the evidence requires it, and keep D-047's causal date rule and its test holding. Regenerate the layout, the generated research reports and the calibration report with the repository's tools; every moved golden or pin carries a measured attribution. A change table (node, before, after, option chosen, sources) goes into a new dated section of the date review and into the lane report. The date review's F-R, G and T are not part of DH7: report them, do not apply them.

(4) VALIDATION AND DOCUMENTS. Tier 1, Tier 2, then full Tier 3 in your clone (scripts/validate.sh), every full suite under flock on the shared lock; bounded mutants with semantic kills; the doc-link check; a dated section in the fixes report; the lane report H-RT2.md.
